scripts.text:
[Mariner]
This ship
is heading
towards ^666699Izlude^000000.
Have you enjoyed your time in Jawaii? You should check to see
if you forgot anything before we go.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
这艘船将驶往^666699依斯鲁得岛^000000。
您在爪哇玩得开心吗？出发前，请检查一下有没有落下东西。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Well, then.
Would you like
to go back to Izlude?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
那么，您想回到依斯鲁得岛吗？

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Now, let me
guide you to
Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
现在，让我带您去依斯鲁得岛。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Take your time
and look around as
much as you like.
Somehow,  this is not
a place that you can
visit often, you know?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
慢慢逛，尽情游览吧。
毕竟，这里可不是想来就能常来的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
This ship
is headed back
towards ^003399Alberta^000000.
Have you enjoyed your time in Jawaii? You should check to see
if you forgot anything before we go.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
这艘船将返回^003399艾尔贝塔^000000。
您在爪哇玩得开心吗？出发前，请检查一下有没有落下东西。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Now, are you
ready to go back
to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
那么，您准备好回到艾尔贝塔了吗？

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Now, let me
take you back
to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
现在，让我带您回艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text:
[Mariner]
Yeah...
Try to enjoy your
vacation as much
as you can. We'll be
ready to leave when
you are.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
嗯...尽情享受假期吧。
您什么时候准备好了，我们就什么时候出发。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Oh, dear!
You're not going
to the tavern, are you?
scripts.translation:
[女士]
哎呀！
您不会是要去酒馆吧？

scripts.text: No, I am not.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text: Hell yeah~
scripts.translation: 当然要去~

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Whew~!
Thank goodness!
It's just that...
The tavern probably
isn't the best place for
you to enjoy yourself.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
呼~！谢天谢地！
只是...那家酒馆恐怕不是个适合尽兴的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Even though I work there, I still can't believe that kind of place exists! I mean, I thought alcohol was outlawed in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
虽然我在那里工作，还是不敢相信竟然会有那种地方！
我还以为卢恩·米德加兹王国禁酒呢！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
I have no idea how singles are
able to find this place. But I've heard that lots of different people come here for different reasons.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
真不知道那些单身的人是怎么找到这里的。
听说来这里的人形形色色，各有各的原因。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
I've even seen unmarried single people coming here just to get drunk! Oh! And for some reason, people have been disappearing
from the tavern!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
我甚至见过单身的人专程来这里买醉！
哦！而且不知怎么回事，还有人在酒馆里失踪了！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
I wonder what's going on?
^666666*Sigh*^000000 I'm a waitress there, but still I just want to tell you not to go in there...
scripts.translation:
[女士]
那里到底出了什么事呢？
^666666*叹气*^000000 虽然我是那里的女服务员，还是想劝您别进去...

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
You know what's
the most beautiful
place in Jawaii?
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
您知道爪哇最美的地方是哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
It's 'Heart Island,' which is just a little north of here. The water surrounding Heart Island is not that deep, so you can just walk across if you're careful.
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
是“心之岛”，就在我们北边不远处。心之岛周围的水不深，只要小心一点，您可以直接走过去。

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
That's the best place to share an intimate moment with the person
you love. It's perfectly secluded and such a beautiful area.
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
那是与您所爱之人共享亲密时刻的最佳地点。那里非常隐蔽，景色也很美。

scripts.text:
[Jawa Jawa]
Of course, it's probably not
a good idea to go there by
yourself if you're single.
You'd look like such
a pathetic loser!
scripts.translation:
[爪哇爪哇]
当然，单身的话，最好别一个人去。
看起来会像个可怜的失意者！

scripts.text:
[Waii Waii]
Welcome to Jawaii!
scripts.translation:
[怀怀]
欢迎来到爪哇！

scripts.text:
[Waii Waii]
Here, you can enjoy your
honeymoon without worrying about any interruptions. You don't even have to bother with that notorious Single Army!
scripts.translation:
[怀怀]
在这里，您可以安心享受蜜月，不用担心被打扰。您甚至不用理会那个臭名昭著的单身军团！

scripts.text:
[Waii Waii]
Well, there are a few monsters around, but you'll be okay as long as you don't attack them first. Think of them as the original residents of this island, another sight to enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[怀怀]
嗯，周围有一些魔物，但只要您不先攻击它们，就没关系。把它们当作这座岛的原住民，也是这里的一道风景吧。

scripts.text:
[Waja Waja]
Ah, you must be a tourist.
If you're lost, just head West. Accommodations for newlyweds
are located in the western part of Jawaii. The lodging here is
pretty amazing.
scripts.translation:
[瓦贾瓦贾]
啊，您是游客吧。
迷路的话，就往西走。爪哇西边有专供新婚夫妇入住的客房，条件相当不错。

scripts.text:
[Waja Waja]
There are four different themed rooms, so you can choose one to your liking. There's a Guide around if you want to ask for more information.
scripts.translation:
[瓦贾瓦贾]
这里有四种不同主题的客房，您可以选择自己喜欢的。如果您想了解更多资讯，附近有一位向导。

scripts.text:
[Waja Waja]
When you want to go back, please head to the NorthWest to board
a ship to Alberta. If you want to sail to Izlude, there's a ship waiting in the SouthEast.
scripts.translation:
[瓦贾瓦贾]
当您想回去时，请前往西北方搭乘前往艾尔贝塔的船。如果您想前往依斯鲁得岛，东南方有一艘船在等待。

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Jawaii~
Jawa~ii~
Where you can
find happiness~
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
爪哇~
爪~哇~
幸福就在这里~

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Oh, isn't it beautiful? You don't have to do anything other than relax and breathe in the peaceful atmosphere. That's one of the
best things about Jawaii.
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
哦，这里美不美？您只需要放松身心，呼吸这宁静的空气。这就是爪哇最棒的地方之一。

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Ooh! Sometimes we hold
concerts on this stage. If you're good at singing, why don't you
go up on stage and sing
a song for us?
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
噢！有时候我们会在这个舞台上举办音乐会。如果您擅长唱歌，何不走上舞台为我们唱首歌呢？

scripts.text:
[Iwa Iwa]
Jawaii~
Jawa~ii~
Where you can
find happiness~
scripts.translation:
[伊瓦伊瓦]
爪哇~
爪~哇~
幸福就在这里~

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
W-Welcome...?
This is o-o-our
s-sweet room.
We, we just c-cleaned
this r-room for you
o-of course.
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
欢...欢迎...？
这...这是我们的甜...甜蜜房。
当...当然，我...我们刚替您打...打扫过了。

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
Th-The charge is is
1000 zeny p-p-per person?
P-please pay me the fee and
I,I'll let you in. I ssss...swear!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
费...费用是每人1000 Zeny？
请...请先付钱，我...我就让您进去。
我...我发誓！

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
I, I'll also ca-carry your luggage. B-but pay me first. Otherwise, my bo-boss will be unhappy and... ^666666*Gulp*^000000
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
我...我也会帮您搬行李。
但...但得先付钱。不然，老...老板会不高兴，然后...^666666*咽口水*^000000

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
^333333Beat me to death...^000000
Use.
scripts.translation: 入住

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
T-Thank you ssso much!
L-Let open the room door
ffffor you. Thank y-you.
Ha-have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
太...太感谢您了！
我...我这就替您开...开门。谢...谢谢。
祝...祝您玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
Oh no! Oh no no no no no.
Th-This isn't enough money?
I-I'm ssssorry, but my b-boss w-will beat me if I l-let you
in without paying...
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
糟了！不不不，糟了！
这...这些钱不够？
对...对不起，不付钱就让您进去，老...老板会打我的...

scripts.text:
[Alowa]
^666666*Sniff*^000000
B-but I promise th-that this room is the nicest and cl-cleanest room! P-Please! C-come back!
scripts.translation:
[阿洛瓦]
^666666*抽泣*^000000
但...但我保证这间房是最漂亮、最...最干净的房间！请...请回来吧！

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Welcome to
the Antique room.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
欢迎来到古董主题房。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
This room provides lovers with
an atmosphere of plush elegance.
Every comfort is provided for
young couples in this room.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
这间客房奢华优雅，为年轻情侣提供舒适周到的住宿体验。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
All the rooms may have the same basic structure, but each of them has their own unique interior to suit the tastes of different people.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
虽然所有房间的基本结构都相同，但每间房都有独特的内部装饰，以迎合不同人的品味。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
If you would like to lodge here, it is required to pay a 1,000 zeny fee for each person before entering. Since you're here to make fond memories of your honeymoon,
you should stay in the nicest room.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
如果您想在此住宿，进入前每人需支付1,000 Zeny的费用。
既然您是来度过蜜月、创造美好回忆的，就应该选择最漂亮的房间。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Do not hesitate to let me know when you've decided on the Antique Room. Once you've made your choice,
I will guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
决定入住古董主题房的话，随时告诉我。
选好后，我会带您过去。

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 入住

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Thank you
for using
our services.
Please...
Make yourself
comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
感谢您使用我们的服务。
请...安心休息，祝您住得舒适。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
I am sorry, but you don't seem to have enough money. If it's alright, why don't you check your current funds and see what you can do
about this situation?
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
很抱歉，您的钱似乎不够。
方便的话，请确认一下手头的钱，看看能不能想想办法。

scripts.text:
[Pine Oran]
Please...
Take your time.
There should be no rush
when it comes to leisure.
scripts.translation:
[派恩·奥兰]
请...慢慢来。
享受闲暇，不必着急。

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
I'll take you
to the Honey Room.
It costs 1,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼娅]
我带你去蜂蜜主题房，费用是1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
So you wanna go?
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼娅]
怎么样，要去吗？

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 入住

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
Eh, alright.
Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼娅]
嗯，好吧。
我们出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
You...
Don't have
enough money.
C'mon, romance
takes zeny, got it?
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼娅]
你...钱不够。
拜托，浪漫也要花Zeny的，懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharkie Rania]
No prob.
scripts.translation:
[沙基·拉尼娅]
没问题。

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Hello dear,
how are you?
Are you looking for
a room to stay in?
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
你好，亲爱的，最近怎么样？
你是在找住的地方吗？

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
This is called the Villa Room.
I recommend this room to people
who prefer to stay in a place with
a comfortable atmosphere
much like home.
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
这是别墅主题房。
想住得像在家一样温馨舒适，我推荐你选这间。

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Just like all the other rooms,
the lodging charge is 1,000 zeny.
I can guide you to the Villa Room
right now, if you wish. Would you
like to stay?
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
和其他客房一样，住宿费是1,000 Zeny。
愿意的话，我现在就能带您去别墅主题房。
您要入住吗？

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 入住

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Thank you~
Enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
谢谢~
祝您住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
Oh what a shame!
You don't seem
to have enough money...?
Why don't you ask your
partner to help you
with the charge?
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
真遗憾！您的钱似乎不够...？
不如请伴侣帮忙付一下房费？

scripts.text:
[Larks Rania]
No problem~
If you like, you may wish to check the Honey Room. Although the roomkeeper, Sharkie, is a shy girl, the room is really beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[拉克斯·拉尼娅]
没问题~
如果您喜欢，也可以去看看蜂蜜主题房。虽然房间管理员沙基是个害羞的女孩，但那间房真的很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
There is no place
better for having your
honeymoon than Jawaii.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
没有比爪哇更适合度蜜月的地方了。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Why don't you make the best of your time here, and make a lot of sweet memories that you will cherish for years to come?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
何不尽情享受这里的时光，留下值得珍藏一生的甜蜜回忆？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Mementos that remind you of your happy times can be your most precious possessions. Like your wedding ring, for instance, or the tuxedo and wedding dress worn during your wedding ceremony...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
能让您想起幸福时光的纪念品，往往最值得珍惜。
比如结婚戒指，或婚礼上穿的燕尾服和结婚礼服...

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Even if the wedding ceremony
is over, isn't it nice to look back upon the happy memories of your marriage ceremony? With the magical photo album at a cheap price, now you can!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
婚礼虽然结束了，能重温当时的幸福回忆，不也很美好吗？
现在，只要花一点钱买本魔法相册，就能做到！

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Its name is...
'Sweet Memory of Marriage'!!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
它的名字是...
“甜蜜婚忆”！！

scripts.text:
[Helper]
It will instantly bring you to the wedding hall with magic power!
And it only costs 50,000 zeny...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
它能通过魔力瞬间将您传送到婚礼大厅！
而且只需要50,000 Zeny...

scripts.text: I shall buy it.
scripts.translation: 我要买

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Thank you very much~!
Please remember, you
should use this with your
partner in a place that is
special to the both of you.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
非常感谢~！
记得和伴侣一起，在对你们两人有特殊意义的地方使用哦。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
'Sweet Memory of Marriage' is 50,000 zeny. But don't seem to have enough money with you right now. Maybe you and your partner could help each other to buy the Sweet Memory of Marriage?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
“甜蜜婚忆”售价50,000 Zeny。但您似乎手头资金不足。也许您可以和您的伴侣一起凑钱购买“甜蜜婚忆”呢？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Even if your relationship ends,
the memories the both of you have shared will remain forever...
scripts.translation:
[助手]
即使感情走到了尽头，你们共同的回忆也会永远留存...

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
Anyway, I am so glad that you two have gotten married. I hope you both will live happily ever after~
scripts.translation:
[员工 特莱泰]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
真为你们喜结连理感到高兴。愿你们永远幸福~

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you enjoy your stay
over here. But try not
to drink too much~
scripts.translation:
[员工 特莱泰]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
希望你们在这里度过愉快的时光。但请尽量不要喝太多~

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you will have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[员工 特莱泰]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
希望你们玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Employee Tryteh]
Try to be a little careful if you bump into any rude customers.
They might be drunk and do something stupid. You know
how it is...
scripts.translation:
[员工 特莱泰]
如果遇到粗鲁的顾客，请小心一点。
他们可能喝醉了，会做出傻事。你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[员工 菲伊]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
Have a good time! But please,
try not to interrupt the happily married people here!
scripts.translation:
[员工 菲伊]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
祝你玩得开心！不过，请别打扰这里的幸福夫妻哦！

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you will have a good time~
scripts.translation:
[员工 菲伊]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
希望你们玩得开心~

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
We hope that you enjoy your time here with the one that you love. Isn't this place nice and cozy,
a perfect romantic atmosphere?
scripts.translation:
[员工 菲伊]
希望你能在这里和爱人共度美好时光。
这里温馨又舒适，是不是很浪漫？

scripts.text:
[Employee Fey]
It would be absolutely perfect if it weren't for those 'Invincible Single Army' weirdos. Somehow,
a few of those dorks found their way here. To hell with them!
scripts.translation:
[员工 菲伊]
要不是那些“无敌单身军团”的怪人，这里就完美了。
不知怎么的，那几个傻瓜居然找到了这里。去他们的！

scripts.text:
[Employee Buffy]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[员工 巴菲]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~

scripts.text:
[Employee Buffy]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you will have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[员工 巴菲]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
希望你们玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Employee Buffy]
Oh~
Look at you...
You look perfect
for your wife~
Awwww, I want to
get married soon~!
scripts.translation:
[员工 巴菲]

at cooking and cleaning
^666666*AHEM*^000000 I've got a ^FF0000nice body^000000.

bother the married couples!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Employee Tonia]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~

scripts.translation:

欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~

scripts.text:
[Employee Tonia]
Congratulations to both of you!
scripts.translation:
[员工 托尼娅]
恭喜你们俩！

scripts.text:
[Employee Tonia]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
^333333I hope those Single Army morons don't get drunk and do something stupid again...

^666666*叹气...*^000000
^333333希望那些“单身军团”的傻瓜别再喝醉了干蠢事...

scripts.text:
[Employee Tonia]
Hey--!
You're not welcome here!
S-Stop drinking! Right this instant!
scripts.translation:

嘿——！
这里不欢迎你！

scripts.text:
[Employee Kay]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[员工 凯]

Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~

scripts.translation:
[员工 凯]

scripts.text:
[Employee Kay]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you will have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[员工 凯]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
希望你们玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Employee Kay]
Oh gosh...!
Lately, I've been dealing with too many drunks in this place! It's been really hard for me to take care of it all...
scripts.translation:
[员工 凯]
天哪...！最近这里的醉汉太多了，实在应付不过来...

scripts.text:
[Employee Amy]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
Oh! You and your partner look perfect for each other. Like, um,
a gun and a bullet! No...?
scripts.translation:
[员工 艾米]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
哦！你和伴侣真般配，就像...嗯，枪和子弹！
不对...？

scripts.text:
[Employee Amy]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[员工 艾米]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Employee Amy]
How about...
Milk and cookies?
Gin and tonic?
Jackie Tucker
and Chris Chan...?
Ummmm....
scripts.translation:

那...牛奶和饼干？
金酒和汤力水？
杰基·塔克和克里斯·陈...？
唔...

scripts.text:
[Employee Amy]
Hmm, I don't think this place is for you. But, I see no problem in letting you drink and have a good time, so long as you don't
make a fuss.
scripts.translation:
[员工 艾米]
嗯，我觉得这里不太适合你。不过，只要你别闹事，我也没意见让你在这里喝酒消遣。

scripts.text:
[Employee Yasmine]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
Just like the moon and the stars, you and your partner look perfect together. I'm really happy for you!
scripts.translation:

欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~
就像月亮和星星一样，你和你的伴侣看起来天生一对。我真为你们感到高兴！

scripts.text:
[Employee Yasmine]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
scripts.translation:
[员工 雅斯敏]
欢迎来到爪哇酒馆~

scripts.text:
[Employee Yasmine]
Welcome to Jawaii Tavern~
I hope you will have a good time.
scripts.translation:

祝您玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Employee Yasmine]
You don't look like you belong here, but I hope you find your perfect match one of these days. Have fun!
scripts.translation:
[员工 雅斯敏]
你似乎不太适合这里，不过，愿你早日找到心仪的另一半。
玩得开心！

scripts.text:
^3355FF * Wait a minute! *
You're carrying too many items with you right now. Please store some of your things into Kafra Storage and try again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF * 等一下！ *
你现在携带的物品太多了。请将一些物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再试一次。^000000

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Hello,
how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
您好，有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Give me food.
scripts.translation: 来点吃的

scripts.text: Bring me drink.
scripts.translation: 来点喝的

scripts.text: Where's the bar?
scripts.translation: 吧台在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
You can have
1 Meat for 1,000 zeny.
Would you like one?
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
一份肉是1,000 Zeny，您要一份吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 要

scripts.text: Wha--! It's too expensive!
scripts.translation: 什么？！太贵了！

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
There you go~
Enjoy your meal~!
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
给您~
祝您用餐愉快~！

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
I'm sorry but...
This isn't enough money...
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
很抱歉...
您的钱不够...

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
If you
need anything,
please let me know.
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
有什么需要，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
You can have
1 Yellow Potion
at 1,000 zeny.
Would you like one?
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
一瓶黄色药水是1,000 Zeny，您要一瓶吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 要

scripts.text: Wha--! It's too expensive!
scripts.translation: 什么？！太贵了！

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
There you go~
Enjoy your meal~!
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
给您~
祝您用餐愉快~！

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
I am sorry but you don't have enough money?!
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
不好意思，您的钱不够？！

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
If you
need anything,
please let me know.
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
有什么需要，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Oh, just go toward the center
of the tavern. I hope you have
a good time, but be careful and
don't drink too much! Have fun!
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
哦，只要往酒馆中央走就行了。希望您玩得开心，但请小心，别喝太多！玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
Hey, hey...!
I have no idea
why you're here...
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
喂，喂...！真不知道你为什么会来这里...

scripts.text:
[Waitress]
But we don't tolerate singles messing around with the happily married couples around here.
Just have your drink
and then leave!
scripts.translation:
[女服务员]
我们可不允许单身的人在这里骚扰幸福的夫妻。
喝完就走吧！

scripts.text: I'm a member of Single Army!!
scripts.translation: 我是单身军团的一员！！

scripts.text: ...I just wanted to congratulate them...
scripts.translation: ...我只是想祝贺他们...

scripts.text:
[Employee]
Yeah, right.
Knock it off already.
Why can't you be happy
for other people?!
scripts.translation:
[员工]
是是是，别闹了。
你就不能为别人高兴吗？！

scripts.text:
[Employee]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
You will be welcome
here when you visit
with your partner, okay?
scripts.translation:
[员工]
^666666*叹气*^000000
等你和伴侣一起来，我们就欢迎你了，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Employee]
Huh? Did you just
say you wanted to
congratulate them?
Oh, you must be close
friends with one
of the couples...
scripts.translation:
[员工]
咦？你说你是来祝贺他们的？
哦，那你一定是某对夫妻的好朋友...

scripts.text:
[Employee]
I'm sorry!
Let me apologize
for my rudeness.
I hope you have
a good time.
scripts.translation:
[员工]
对不起！请原谅我的无礼。
祝您玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Welcome to the
Jawaii Tavern bar.
What would you
like to drink?
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
欢迎光临爪哇酒馆的吧台。
您想喝点什么？

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Hm, I'm sorry
but you do not
have enough
money for a drink.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
嗯，抱歉，您的钱不够买一杯酒。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
....Hmm...

[{0}]
Hey...!
Bartender...
Gimmie one more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿...！
调酒师...
再给我来一杯。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Okay...
It's on me.
Have a drink.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
好吧...
这杯我请。
请慢用。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you.
Follow Bartender's Recommendation.
scripts.translation: 听调酒师推荐

scripts.text: I want a Gunslinger.
scripts.translation: 来杯神枪手

scripts.text: I want a Cobo.
scripts.translation: 来杯科博

scripts.text: I want a Bomb.
scripts.translation: 来杯炸弹

scripts.text: I want a Boogieman.
scripts.translation: 来杯布基曼

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Hmmm...
You seem to have
had enough to drink.
Are you sure you'll be okay?
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
嗯...您好像已经喝了不少，确定还撑得住吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Bartender,
I'm so depressed
because of...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
调酒师，我心情很低落，因为...

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
There you go...
Let me make
a ^0000FF'Special J&Z'^000000 for you.
And this is on me.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
好吧...
我给你调一杯^0000FF“J&Z特调”^000000。
这杯我请。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you...
So much...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
谢谢...
真的非常感谢...

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Hmm...
How about this cocktail?
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
嗯...
这杯鸡尾酒怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
I recommend
a '^0000FFBarcadie 150^000000.'
It's the drink of pirates!
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
我推荐^0000FF“巴卡迪150”^000000。
这是海盗喝的酒！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examined
the small glass
containing a glossy
brown liquid...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你端详着小玻璃杯，里面盛着泛着光泽的棕色液体...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFAlthough the glass is tiny and only holds a small amount, the liquid inside still smells pretty dangerous...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF虽然玻璃杯很小，只装了一点点，但里面的液体闻起来相当危险...^000000

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
It's strong and flammable,
so you might feel like your
throat is burning.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
这酒很烈，还能点着，喝下去可能会觉得喉咙像在烧。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou gulped it down.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你一口闷了下去。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Hmm...
How about this cocktail?
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
嗯...
这杯鸡尾酒怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
I recommend a '^0000FFBlack Russian Double^000000.' It will make you dream of lying in a vast Russian field...
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
我推荐'^0000FF双份黑俄罗斯^000000'。它会让你梦见躺在广阔的俄罗斯田野上...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examined the large glass holding a dark brown liquid chilled with ice cubes. There's a faint sweetness in the aroma, as well
a musk that reminds you of an old, mustached man.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你观察了那个装着深棕色液体、加着冰块的大玻璃杯。香气中有一丝淡淡的甜味，还有一种让你想起留着胡子的老男人的麝香味。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
I suggest you take your time
drinking this since it's very strong. The Black Russian Double is rumored to be the favorite drink of the Russian mafia.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
建议你慢慢喝，因为它非常烈。据说双份黑俄罗斯是俄罗斯黑手党的最爱。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou drank it sip by sip,
savoring its rich,
robust flavor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你小口小口地喝着，细细品味它浓郁醇厚的滋味。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
So...
How about this..?
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
那么...
这杯怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Why don't you try
a '^0000FFKiss of Fire
the Spinbird Kick^000000?'
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
要不要试试^0000FF“火之吻·旋鸟踢”^000000？

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Don't be fooled by its sweet scent or beautiful red color. This is one of the strongest drinks around.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
别被它甜美的香气或漂亮的红色骗了。这是最烈的饮品之一。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou receive a crystal cocktail glass with a little bit of sugar sprinkled around the rim. It has
a sweet fragrance that makes your mouth water. However, you can also feel that it is a dangerously strong cocktail.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你收到一个水晶鸡尾酒杯，杯口撒了一圈糖。它散发着诱人的甜香，让你垂涎欲滴。然而，你也能感觉到这是一杯烈度极高的鸡尾酒。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Lick the sugar before taking a sip. That will make it taste a little sweeter and will soften the taste.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
喝之前先舔一下糖。那样会尝起来更甜一些，也能缓和口感。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou carefully took a sip.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你小心翼翼地抿了一口。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
I see...
Let me think
of something
you might like.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
我明白了...
让我想想您可能喜欢什么。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Okay, how about
a '^0000FFWhite Margarita'^000000?'
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
好，那^0000FF“白色玛格丽特”^000000怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
You will smell a sourish lemon scent which makes your mouth water. As you taste it, you will be filled with a pleasant, comforting warmth that spreads throughout your body.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
它的柠檬香气酸酸的，让人垂涎欲滴。
喝下去，一股舒适的暖意就会传遍全身。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou receive a fancy cocktail glass with salt and lemon juice sprinkled on the rim. Its sour scent does make your mouth water. How could something so appetizing be dangerous?
scripts.translation: ^3355FF您收到一个精致的鸡尾酒杯，杯口撒着盐和柠檬汁。那股酸味确实让人垂涎欲滴。这么开胃的东西怎么会危险呢？

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
It has a sweet and sour taste so it's favored by female customers
as well. I guarantee that you will enjoy its flavor.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
它酸甜可口，因此也很受女顾客的欢迎。我保证您会喜欢它的味道。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gulp the delicious
Margarita down in one sip.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF您一口气喝光了美味的玛格丽特。^000000

scripts.text: When you want to look super cool, this will be the best drink for you. It's a strong drink with a particular scent, so people who drink Gunslingers are usually seen as having impressive of taste.
scripts.translation: 当你想要耍酷的时候，这是最好的选择。它是一款烈酒，有着独特的香气，所以喝神枪手的人通常会被认为品味不凡。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou received a simple glass containing a gray liquid. Although it smells faintly sweet, it looks like industrial strength liquor. It's time to summon your courage and take a sip~
scripts.translation: ^3355FF您收到一个装着灰色液体的简单玻璃杯。虽然闻起来有点甜，但看起来像是工业级的烈酒。是时候鼓起勇气喝一口了~

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
That drink is bitter and sweet, just like life. Taste it with your tongue, don't drink it all at once.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
这杯酒苦中带甜，就像生活一样。用舌头细细品味，不要一口喝光。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou slowly drank some
of your Gunslinger drink.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你慢慢啜饮着这杯“神枪手”。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeeehaw~!
I'm a cowboy hero!
Bang Bang Bang!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
耶~！
我是牛仔英雄！
砰！砰！砰！

scripts.text: People say that the more you drink a mixed Cobo, the tastier it will be. It grows on you, kind of like the company of an old friend. This is a nice drink to have with anyone at anytime.
scripts.translation: 人们说，混合科博喝得越多，味道就越醇厚。它就像老朋友一样，越处越有味道。这是一款适合在任何时候与任何人共饮的美酒。

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe Bartender brought a beautifully engraved glass holding a cobalt blue liquid and placed it in front of you. It smells pleasantly sweet and sour.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF调酒师端来一个雕刻精美的玻璃杯，里面装着钴蓝色的液体，放在您面前。它闻起来酸甜可口。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Once you taste this once, you almost can't stop drinking. It tastes so smooth and goes
down even smoother.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
尝过一口，就几乎停不下来。
它口感柔和，入喉更是顺滑。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou finished
your drink in 3 sips.
Your mouth was filled
with a luxurious, sweet and
sour flavor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你分三口喝完了这杯酒，口中满是浓郁的酸甜滋味。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Aaaaaahhhhhh~!
This drink is really good!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊~！
这酒真好喝！

scripts.text:
This is for one who wants to relive wild, youthful days, honor those who have fought for justice and liberty, or just to drink alcohol until they vomit stomach acid.
for one who wants to remember people fighting for liberty...
scripts.translation:
这是为那些想要重温狂野青春岁月、致敬为正义与自由而战的人，或者只是想把酒喝到吐出胃酸的人准备的。
为那些想要铭记为自由而战的人们...

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou receive a tumbler filled with brown liquid. It a has a very thick, machine like smell. It kind of reminds you of gunpowder.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你接过一杯棕色液体，浓重的气味像是从机器里散发出来的，让你想起了火药。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
It might look too big to drink at once, but I suggest that you finish it in one gulp. If you drink it slowly, you'll pass out.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
虽然这杯看起来大得没法一口喝完，但我还是建议您一口闷。
慢慢喝的话，会醉倒的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou firmly grabbed
the tumbler and
gulped it down.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你握紧杯子，一口气喝光了。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou feel pretty hammered.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你感觉醉得不轻。^000000

scripts.text: There are not many people who like this drink. But the ones that do like this drink, love it.
scripts.translation: 喜欢这酒的人不多。但喜欢它的人，都会爱死它。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Although it has a beautiful, appetizing color, its appearance can be misleading. Most people feel cold and empty after having some
of this.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
虽然颜色漂亮诱人，但外表可能会骗人。大多数人喝下它之后，都会感到寒冷和空虚。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou receive a crooked glass
filled with purple fluid. Although it smells pleasant, you have a strange feeling of disgust as you draw it closer to your face.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF您收到一个歪歪扭扭的玻璃杯，里面装着紫色的液体。虽然闻起来很香，但凑近时却感到一阵莫名的恶心。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
If you don't want to drink it, tell me now. But it might be good to try it once, just to experience it.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
不想喝的话，现在就告诉我。
不过，不妨尝一口，就当体验一下。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou took a sip of it and sighed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你喝了一口，叹了口气。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFAnd promised yourself that you would never drink it ever again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF并对自己发誓，这辈子再也不喝这种酒了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Master...
One more please...

[Bartender]
It's on me.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
我请客。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you...
Mr. Bartender...

[Bartender]
There you go.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
给你。

scripts.text: [Bartender]
scripts.translation: [调酒师]

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
Grrrr...
Damn! I don't
like this place!
I don't like this at all!
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
呃...
该死！我不喜欢这里！一点也不喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
Hey, why aren't you drinking?
I guess you're all out of dough.
But I know how you feel. Disgusted with all the lovey dovey around this place, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
嘿，怎么不喝了？我猜你是没钱了吧。
不过我懂，看到这里的人到处卿卿我我，很恶心吧？

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
You look happy...
I hope you'll be
able to feel that
way forever...
 
^666666*Hiccup...!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
你看起来很开心...
希望你能永远这么开心...
 
^666666*嗝...！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
I can't believe my eyes! Everyone else looks disgustingly happy! It makes me feel so miserable!
You agree, don't you?!
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
真不敢相信！一个个都幸福得让人恶心，衬得我更惨了！
你也这么觉得吧？！

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
Grrrr...
Bartender!
Give me one more!
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
呃...
调酒师！再来一杯！

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
Heh.
Lemme buy
you a drink!
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
嘿，我请你喝一杯！

scripts.text:
[Buchi]
Drink this at once, and forget about your miserable life! Cheer up, you got the whole future ahead of you and a drink in front of you! Come on, now~!
scripts.translation:
[布奇]
一口闷了，忘掉那些糟心事！
振作点，未来还长着呢，眼前还有酒！来，喝~！

scripts.text: ^3355FFHe ordered a JJ special for me.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF他给我点了一杯JJ特调。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Damn...!
Damn! I will be
the one who laughs last!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
该死...！
该死！
我一定会笑到最后的！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou drank to your fill.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你喝得酩酊大醉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cage]
....Bah!
What are you so happy about?
After all, everyone knows marriage is a sham for desperate, lonely people!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
...哼！
你高兴什么？
毕竟，大家都知道婚姻不过是绝望孤独之人的闹剧！

scripts.text:
[Cage]
Drink, drink...!!
Eat, eat...!!
Join me,
my brother
in singlehood!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
喝，喝...！吃，吃...！
来陪我吧，单身的兄弟！

scripts.text:
[Cage]
I don't trust anybody!
You're a fool for chaining
yourself to some gorgeous
woman for life!
You hear me?!
A FOOL!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
我不信任任何人！
你把自己拴在一个漂亮女人身上过一辈子，真是个大傻瓜！
你听到了吗？！
大傻瓜！

scripts.text:
[Cage]
Look at you!
You're a fool for
chaining yourself to
some pretty boy for life!
You hear me?! A FOOL!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
看看你！
你把自己拴在一个帅哥身上过一辈子，真是个大傻瓜！
你听到了吗？！大傻瓜！

scripts.text:
[Cage]
The single life is
what it's all about!
Women may break my
spirit, but they'll never take...
MY FREEDOM!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
单身才是王道！
女人也许能让我心灰意冷，但永远夺不走...
我的自由！

scripts.text:
[Cage]
We are free...!
We are free from
the hell of marriage...!
We are the sincere and
competent singles...!
scripts.translation:
[凯奇]
我们自由了...！我们不必困在婚姻的地狱里...！
我们是诚实又能干的单身汉...！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
Oh man...
I think I'm drunk~
^666666*Hiccup...!*^000000

[SoloHan]
Oh man...
I think I'm drunk~
*Hiccup!*
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
天哪...
我好像喝醉了~
*打嗝！*

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
Oh man...
I think I'm drunk~
^666666*Hiccup!*^000000

[SoloHan]
Hey, you...!
You understand, don't you?!
Aren't you upset looking at all these happily married couples?!
Yeah~? Me too!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
嘿，你...！
你懂吧？！
看着这些幸福的情侣，难道你不感到难过吗？！
对吧~？我也是！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
How dare they show off their happiness in front of people like us--!! ^666666*Sniff*^000000 Just because they found everlasting love, they think they're better than we are?!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
他们居然敢在我们面前炫耀幸福——！^666666*吸鼻子*^000000
找到天长地久的爱情，就觉得比我们高人一等了？！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
I remember when couples were polite and were lovey dovey behind closed doors. Nowadays they hold hands, and even cuddle in public. I mean, come on! Get a room!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
以前的情侣还懂得分寸，只会关起门来亲热。
现在倒好，大庭广众之下又牵手又搂抱。
拜托，开个房去！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
I mean, ^666666*Sniff*^000000, it's not like,
I'm lonely or anything. I don't neeeeeeeed a woman~!
Right, Bachewcca!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
我是说，^666666*吸鼻子*^000000，我才不孤独呢。
我根本不——需要女人~！
对吧，巴切卡！

scripts.text:
[Bachewcca]
...!

[SoloHan]
It's doesn't really matter whether you're married
or not, right buddy? Right?!
Come on! Drink with me!!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
其实结不结婚都无所谓，对吧兄弟？对吧？！
来吧！跟我一起喝！！

scripts.text:
^3355FFSuddenly he treated me as a close friend. It's a little embarrassing, but it's not a bad idea to accept
a free drink...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF他突然把我当成亲密的朋友。虽然有点尴尬，但接受一杯免费酒似乎也不错...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Gulp Gulp Gulp *^000000

[SoloHan]
So, what do you say?
Let's go somewhere
with some real liquor.
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
怎么样？我们找个有真正烈酒的地方喝去。

scripts.text: ...One more drink.
scripts.translation: ...再来一杯

scripts.text: ...What kind of place is it?
scripts.translation: ...那是个什么样的地方？

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
Yeah~!
That's the spirit!
Hey, Bachewcca...
Let's drink!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
没错~！
这就对了！
嘿，巴切卡...
干杯！

scripts.text:
[Bachewcca]
^666666*Grunt!*^000000

[SoloHan]
To...
To being single!
F-Forever!!!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
为了...为了单身！
永...永远！！！

scripts.text: ^3355FF* Gulp Gulp Gulp *^000000

[SoloHan]
Whoa...
You alright?
You seem kind of drunk...
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
哇...
你没事吧？
你好像有点醉了...

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
[SoloHan]
^666666*Hiccup!*^000000
So you feel like having some
real fun? Okay, then just sign over here. Count on me, I'll send you to paradise.
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
[独行汉]
^666666*嗝！*^000000
想好好玩一场？那就在这里签个字。
包在我身上，我送你去天堂。

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
[SoloHan]
Drink, drink!
That's not enough!
Drink more, buddy!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
[独行汉]
喝，喝！还不够！再喝点，兄弟！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
I guess now's the perfect time to have you sign this! Don't worry, I'll send you straight to paradise!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
现在正好，你把这个签了吧！
别担心，我送你直达天堂！

scripts.text: Sign
scripts.translation: 签字

scripts.text: Refuse to Sign
scripts.translation: 拒绝签字

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
Alright!
Take care!
Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
好的！
保重！
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
Oh...
Man.
So, you spoil parties
like this all the time, eh?
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
哦...天哪。
你总是这么扫兴吗？

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
^666666*Hiccup!*^000000
So you feel like having some
real fun? Okay, then just sign over here. Count on me, I'll send you to paradise.
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
^666666*嗝！*^000000
想好好玩一场？那就在这里签个字。
包在我身上，我送你去天堂。

scripts.text: Sign
scripts.translation: 签字

scripts.text: Refuse to Sign
scripts.translation: 拒绝签字

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
Alright~!
Take care and have fun!
Harass some couples over there for me, will you?
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
好的~！
保重，玩得开心！
帮我骚扰一下那边的情侣，好吗？

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
Oh...
Man.
No wonder you're single. You can't even recognize a good time when it's right in front of you.
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
哦...天哪。
难怪你单身，眼前就有乐子，你都不知道享受。

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
Drink, drink!
That's not enough!
Drink more, buddy!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
喝，喝！
不够！
再喝点，兄弟！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
To...
To being single!
FOR EVER.
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
为...为单身干杯！
永远单身！

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Gulp Gulp Gulp*^000000

[SoloHan]
...Wha!?
Oh man!
Get outta my face!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
...什么？！天哪！离我远点！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
...Wha!?
Oh man!
Get outta my face!
You smell like,
whupped boyfriend
or something!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
...什么？！天哪！离我远点！
你一看就是个被女朋友管得死死的家伙！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
I think I know a naggy wife
when I see one! Go boss your
hubby around or something!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
一看就知道，你是个爱唠叨的老婆！
去对你老公发号施令吧！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
Leave me alone!
I don't want any of your marital bliss to rub off on me. Come on, Bachewcca! Tell 'em their kind ain't welcome here!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
别烦我！我可不想沾上你们那股婚姻的幸福味！
巴切卡！告诉他们，我们不欢迎这种人！

scripts.text:
[SoloHan]
What is that...?
Is this the third time this week I've gotten plastered? Bachewcca, help me count!
scripts.translation:
[独行汉]
怎么回事...？这是我这周第三次喝得烂醉了？
巴切卡，帮我数数！

scripts.text:
[Bachewcca]
..............
^666666*Gulp....gulp...*^000000
Grrrrr!! That hit the spot!

[Helper]
Newlyweds and
long time couples...
We invite you to Jawaii,
the honeymoon resort!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
不论新婚夫妇，还是老夫老妻...
我们都诚邀您前往蜜月度假胜地——爪哇！

scripts.text: Jawaii?
scripts.translation: 爪哇？

scripts.text: Let's go to Jawaii~!
scripts.translation: 去爪哇吧~！

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Helper]
There is an island far, far away from the Midgard continent.
It is a very quiet and beautiful island resort that only opens
its doors to couples.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
远离米德加尔特大陆的地方，有一座美丽宁静的度假岛屿，只对情侣开放。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
This is an exclusive travel offer to the special honeymoon resort for Midgard's citizens. The price, 100,000 zeny, may be expensive, but you really get what you pay for.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
这是专为米德加尔特居民推出的蜜月旅行，目的地是特别的度假胜地。
费用是100,000 Zeny，虽然不便宜，却绝对物有所值。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
I guarantee you that some of
the happiest moments you can
experience in your marriage will be on this island. Can you really put a price on that?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
我保证，在这座岛上，您会度过婚姻中最幸福的时光。
这样的体验，哪能用金钱衡量？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Errm...
Unfortunately, singles are not allowed on the island. Why don't you go forget your loneliness in the Prontera pub?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
呃...很遗憾，单身人士不能上岛。
不如去普隆德拉的酒吧，暂时忘掉孤独吧？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
Bon Voyage...!!
Let me guide
you to 'Jawaii!'
scripts.translation:
[助手]
一路顺风！
我这就带您前往爪哇！

scripts.text:
[Helper]
As I explained, you must have 100,000 zeny in order to visit Jawaii. Why don't you ask your partner for help in gathering the zeny for this trip?
scripts.translation:
[助手]
刚才说过，前往爪哇需要100,000 Zeny。
不如请伴侣帮忙，一起凑够旅费？

scripts.text:
[Helper]
There's there no better way to share special, secluded moments with your beloved than through
a secret trip to a remote, exotic area.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
悄悄去遥远的异域旅行，和爱人享受独处的甜蜜时光，没有比这更浪漫的事了。

scripts.text:
[Helper]
A vacation in Jawaii could very well be the greatest gift that you could give to the one you love~
scripts.translation:
[助手]
一次爪哇假期，也许就是送给爱人最好的礼物~
